scientific_integrity: The formulas for all prime powers are proved by exact prime-adic Gauss sums and independently checked numerically in 21 cases. These checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Unmodified cyclic prime-power cubic chirps, full unweighted projector orbits only; standard Gauss sums and generic Weyl diagonalization are prior theory; qualitative Alltop noninjectivity is prior known. Older polyphase-sequence ambiguity spectrum may overlap.
title: The full three-characteristic Gabor projector spectrum of prime-power cubic chirps
